components.name: Package Substrate (Organic Substrate)

components.name: Interposer (if used)
components.reasoning: In some advanced SoC packages, an interposer (silicon or organic) is used between die and substrate to provide high-density interconnects. It is a separate component though not present in all designs.

components.name: Ball Grid Array (BGA) Solder Balls
components.reasoning: These solder balls form the external electrical interface allowing connection to the smartphone mainboard; they are a standardized assembled component in the package.

components.name: Encapsulation Mold Compound
components.reasoning: The plastic encapsulation protects the delicate silicon die and interconnections from mechanical damage and environmental exposure; procured separately for molding during packaging.

components.name: Thermal Interface Material (TIM)
components.reasoning: Used between the die and heat spreader or package lid to facilitate heat dissipation, it is a procurable material often supplied separately.

components.name: Heat Spreader / Lid (Metal Cover)
components.reasoning: A metal cover attached over the package to protect and assist heat dissipation; a separate manufactured component in the package assembly process.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Smartphone Application Processor (SoC) Package refers to the complete packaged system on chip module that includes the silicon die encapsulated with an interposer, substrate, and external interface pins, ready for integration onto a smartphone motherboard.

This packaged SoC module is the procurable unit integrated on smartphone PCBs, representing the dominant variant in mobile device manufacturing.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Smartphone Application Processor (SoC) Package is an advanced semiconductor packaging assembly that integrates the processor die with structural and interconnection components, enabling electrical, thermal, and mechanical interfacing within a smartphone device.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification reflects the standard industry approach where the SoC package includes not only the silicon die but also the substrate, encapsulation, and interconnects essential for integration into the smartphone mainboard. Such SoC packages are critical for performance, protection, and assembly, and they are widely adopted in consumer smartphones due to miniaturization and thermal demands.

components.name: Underfill Material

components.name: Redistribution Layer (RDL)
